content: Streamlit dashboards that present pretrained-model results follow a consumer-only architecture: the app never trains models, it loads serialized artifacts (pickled model/predictions/panel data) from disk at startup and uses st.cache_data/st.cache_resource to avoid reloading on every rerun/widget interaction. Recommended layout: a thin app.py entry point plus separate modules for data loading and plot generation (e.g. plots.py for Plotly figures), keeping the Streamlit script declarative. For a local-only academic demo (no cloud deploy), the dashboard simply reads from the project's local data/ and results/ directories -- no API layer needed.
